meta.title: Vlog教程｜更适合普通人的手机拍摄教学
meta.title_en: Vlog Tutorial | Mobile Filming for Regular People

scenes.title_cn: 开场：这是你最近拍摄的无Log素材，…
scenes.title_en: Opening: These are your latest unstyled cl…
scenes.context: 乱拍导致素材爆炸，是普通人拍vlog的通病。
sentences: 这是你最近拍摄的无Log素材，兴冲冲的举起手机就一顿乱拍。
These are your latest clips—you excitedly whipped out your phone and shot everything.
The chaotic-shooting trap.
回来发现273个视频，根本不知道该怎么开始剪。
You come home to 273 videos and have no idea where to start editing.
Too much, no structure.
出不了篇就算了，还严重影响了自己当时游玩的心情。
Not posting is bad enough—it even ruined your mood during the trip.
Shooting without a plan hurts.
scenes.speak: These are your latest clips—you excitedly whipped out your phone and shot everything. You come home to 273 videos and have no idea where to start editing. Not posting is bad enough—it even ruined your mood during the trip.

scenes.title_cn: 新方法：既然不知道拍什么，那在每个场…
scenes.title_en: The new method: since you don't know what …
scenes.context: 四类镜头的固定配方，让拍摄有章法。
sentences: 既然不知道要拍什么，那就在每个场景下只记录这四种画面。
Since you don't know what to shoot, just record these four kinds of shots in each scene.
Four shots per scene.
场景空镜，物品特写，人物全景，人物近景。
Scene wide shots, item close-ups, full-body people, and close person shots.
The four-shot formula.
scenes.speak: Since you don't know what to shoot, just record these four kinds of shots in each scene. Scene wide shots, item close-ups, full-body people, and close person shots.

scenes.title_cn: 空镜拍摄：可用固定拍摄，尽量让画面内…
scenes.title_en: Wide shots: use fixed shooting and let thi…
scenes.context: 空镜要有动感，移动镜头用稳定器保证稳定。
sentences: 拍摄场景空镜时，可以选择使用固定拍摄，尽量保证画面内的物体运动起来。
For wide shots, you can use fixed shooting and try to keep things moving inside the frame.
Motion inside the frame.
同时也可以使用更有氛围感的移动拍摄。
You can also use more atmospheric moving shots.
Moving shots add mood.
拍摄一些慢慢横移的画面，又或者是使用自由抚养模式拍摄升降的画面。
Shoot slow horizontal pans, or use free-tilt mode for rising and lowering moves.
Pan and tilt moves.
来增加画面的电影感。
To add a cinematic feel.
Cinematic flair.
scenes.speak: For wide shots, you can use fixed shooting and try to keep things moving inside the frame. You can also use more atmospheric moving shots. Shoot slow horizontal pans, or use free-tilt mode for rising and lowering moves. To add a cinematic feel.

scenes.title_cn: 人物全景：把手放到较远位置，打开三脚…
scenes.title_en: Full-body shots: place the phone farther a…
scenes.context: 全景兼顾环境与人物，入画动作更自然。
sentences: 可以把手拿到比较远的位置，来获得人物全景的画面。
You can place the phone farther away to get a full-body shot of the person.
Frame the whole person.
打开自带的三角架和延长杆，选择固定镜头拍摄，让人物慢慢入画。
Open the built-in tripod and extension rod, fix the shot, and let the person slowly enter the frame.
Let them walk in.
这样就能把环境和人物一起记录下来。
This captures both the environment and the person together.
Context plus subject.
scenes.speak: You can place the phone farther away to get a full-body shot of the person. Open the built-in tripod and extension rod, fix the shot, and let the person slowly enter the frame. This captures both the environment and the person together.

scenes.title_cn: 追踪拍摄：使用稳定器自带的追踪功能拍…
scenes.title_en: Tracking: use the gimbal's built-in tracki…
scenes.context: 稳定器的原生追踪让移动拍摄无死角。
sentences: 也可以使用稳定器自带的追踪功能，来拍摄一段人物移动的画面。
You can also use the gimbal's built-in tracking to film the person moving.
Let the gimbal follow.
哪怕是大范围的环绕移动，也能保证水平360度的无死角跟拍。
Even large circling moves deliver seamless 360-degree tracking.
360-degree no-dead-angle tracking.
完全不用担心人物出镜拍不到的问题。
No worries about the person leaving the frame.
Always in frame.
不管怎么移动，都能保证人物始终在画面的中心。
No matter how you move, the person stays centered.
Always centered.
点击智能美学构图，就能调整跟踪的位置。
Tap smart composition to adjust the tracking position.
Fine-tune the framing.
scenes.speak: You can also use the gimbal's built-in tracking to film the person moving. Even large circling moves deliver seamless 360-degree tracking. No worries about the person leaving the frame. No matter how you move, the person stays centered. Tap smart composition to adjust the tracking position.

scenes.title_cn: 人物近景：配合一些人物进行画面，让身…
scenes.title_en: Close person shots: add shots of the perso…
scenes.context: 近景让视觉焦点明确，副屏遥控提升效率。
sentences: 配合上一些人物进行画面，视觉的焦点就会更明确。
Add some in-action person shots and the visual focus becomes clearer.
Action shots add focus.
让自己的身体站满拍摄画面的一半，然后继续做手上的事情就好。
Fill half the frame with your body and just keep doing what you're doing.
Half-frame, natural action.
配合上另一台手机，使用副屏遥控的功能，就能更高效的把画面调整成自己想要的樣子。
Pair a second phone and use remote preview to frame the shot efficiently.
Remote preview control.
scenes.speak: Add some in-action person shots and the visual focus becomes clearer. Fill half the frame with your body and just keep doing what you're doing. Pair a second phone and use remote preview to frame the shot efficiently.

scenes.title_cn: 物品特写：拍摄当下拿着的物品或环境里…
scenes.title_en: Item close-ups: film what you're holding o…
scenes.context: 特写镜头让观众更身临其境。
sentences: 拍摄一些物品特写的镜头，不管是当下拿着的物品，还是环境里的小东西。
Shoot item close-ups, whether it's what you're holding or small things in the environment.
Details everywhere.
都可以把他们拍摄下来，来增加整个视频的沉浸感。
Film them all to increase the immersion of the video.
Immersion through detail.
scenes.speak: Shoot item close-ups, whether it's what you're holding or small things in the environment. Film them all to increase the immersion of the video.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：把这四种画面进行随机组合，配上…
scenes.title_en: Ending: mix and match these four kinds of …
scenes.context: 组合剪辑+音乐，最终成型。
sentences: 只需要把这四种画面进行上下随机组合。
Just mix and match these four kinds of shots.
Assemble the four types.
再配上一首自己喜欢的音乐，整个视频就会变得更有电影感。
Add a song you love and the video becomes more cinematic.
Music sells the mood.
同时也会更有自己的风格。
And it'll feel more like your own style.
Your signature look.
scenes.speak: Just mix and match these four kinds of shots. Add a song you love and the video becomes more cinematic. And it'll feel more like your own style.

practice: Shoot wide, close-up, full-body, and action shots.
Keep things moving inside the frame.
Let the gimbal track the person 360 degrees.
Fill half the frame and keep doing your thing.
pitfalls: Record four kinds of shots per scene.
每个场景只拍四种画面，避免素材爆炸。
Hold the camera still for wide shots.
Keep things moving inside the frame.
空镜要让物体动起来才有重点。
Chase the person with your hands.
Let the gimbal's tracking keep them centered.
用稳定器追踪，人始终在画面中心。
Add person and close-up shots for focus.
近景和人物让视觉焦点更明确。
shifts: 用 four shots per scene（每场景四镜头）、wide shot（空镜）、close-up（特写）
用 slow pan（慢横移）、rise and lower（升降）、fixed shot（固定镜头）
用 cinematic feel（电影感）、immersion（沉浸感）、mix and match（随机组合）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：无Log素材、四种画面（场景空镜/物品特写/人物全景/人物近景）、固定拍摄、移动拍摄、Flow2 Pro、智能美学构图、副屏遥控、随机组合、电影感等。
